# MyBoiler.com

> Guides, fault codes, and tools for UK boilers, heat pumps, and heating controls. Advice is guidance. Gas work stays with a Gas Safe registered engineer.

Pages are static HTML. Each content page has a title, a description, a canonical URL, and WebPage structured data. The full URL list is https://myboiler.com/sitemap.xml.

## Start here

- [Advice](https://myboiler.com/advice/): Boiler, OpenTherm, heat pump, and heating guides.
- [Fault codes](https://myboiler.com/fault-codes/): Search a display code by brand.
- [Boiler optimiser](https://myboiler.com/boiler-optimiser/): Heating flow temperature and maximum heating output for a condensing boiler.
- [Heat pump checker](https://myboiler.com/heat-pump-checker/): Whether a house is a plausible heat-pump candidate.
- [Boiler pressure](https://myboiler.com/boiler-pressure/): About 1.2 bar when cold, in the 1 to 2 bar band.
- [Combi boiler problems](https://myboiler.com/combi-boiler-problems/): Low pressure, no hot water, cold radiators, condensate, kettling.
- [OpenTherm boilers and controls](https://myboiler.com/opentherm/opentherm-boilers-and-controls/): Brands and models with OpenTherm support.
- [Calculators](https://myboiler.com/calculators/): Flow rate, gas rate, heat output, and system sizing.
- [Quote](https://myboiler.com/quote/): Ask a Gas Safe registered engineer for a quote.
- [Ask AI](https://myboiler.com/chat/): Boiler Help, for heating and hot water questions.

## About the site

- [Mission](https://myboiler.com/mission/): The site is a heating guide, not an installer.
- [Privacy](https://myboiler.com/privacy-policy/): Browsing does not set cookies or identify a visitor.
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://myboiler.com/affilate-activity-disclosure/): Some shopping and partner links pay a commission.
